messages:
Sam: 🚀 We just crossed $5M ARR this quarter — huge props to everyone!!! 
Maya: omg!!!! 🎉🎉🎉 that's insane, congrats team!! 
Lee: Incredible work — shipping + reliability teams deserve extra cookies. 
Jordan: @Sam do we have a tiny celebration in the SF office today? would love to bring cider. 
Sam: @Jordan yes — impromptu 4:30pm in the kitchen. bring something if you want. tiny pinata also sanctioned by @Maya :pinata: 
Ciara: I'll bring sparkling cider and a playlist (80s bops). 
Maya: I'll handle a small snack spread. someone bring napkins lol 
Lee: can we get a mini gong for dramatic reveal pls :laughing: 
Jordan: deploy-bot: "Rolling confetti sequence" (not a real command) :confetti_ball: 
deploy-bot: :robot_face: Congrats team! Automated celebratory emoji sequence triggered. :tada: :tada: 
Sam: Also quick shoutout to billing + growth — retention uptick made this possible. major kudos. 
Ciara: group selfie when we pop the pinata? 
Maya: yes please. and post in #random after. 
Lee: if anyone remote wants a virtual cheers, ping me and I'll open a 5m Zoom huddle. 
Jordan: will do. thanks everyone — feels amazing to hit this milestone together. :heart: 
Sam: @here thanks all. five more years of this pls :sweat_smile: 
Ciara: (reaction) :thumbsup: on all messages
